part.Name: Description
part.Short: Pale flesh still carries a faint thread of cold light down its spine.

part.Name: Food
part.Message: It glows faintly on the way down.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: The strips are strung with thin sinew that will not lie flat.

part.Name: Food
part.Message: Tough, and it fights the jaw.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: The flesh is translucent, and cold to the back of the hand.

part.Name: Food
part.Message: It tastes of deep water and old ice.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Rings of muscle narrow toward a mouth that was all of teeth.

part.Name: Food
part.Message: Something you cannot quite name goes quiet.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Moist fat dissolves slowly from between the fibres, the way the urchin's own flesh did.
